source_title: 점심시간에 쓰는 어제 그송성채에서 있었던 일.jpg
subtitle: 그송성채 앞 보축 대신 본인 무적 켜고 튄 성기사

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
그송성채 깔끔하게 깼네!
입구 나와서 한숨 돌리자
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle establishing shot outside a medieval stone keep archway in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with a minimal cobblestone ground patch. On the left, cheerful Skyborne Mage (sky-blue high side-ponytail, tilted blue wizard hat with smiling cloud-wing badge, cloud capelet, single blue crystal staff stowed on back) stretches both empty arms happily after clearing the dungeon. On the right, relaxed Undead Paladin (round white skull cap, silver bob, white-gold cape, compact one-handed mace and sturdy gold kite shield stowed neatly on back) nods tiredly beside her.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
으악!! 만렙 호드 기습이다!
기사님 보호의 축복 빨리!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle ambush action shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dusty cobblestone ground touch. On the left, terrified Skyborne Mage (sky-blue high side-ponytail, tilted blue wizard hat with smiling cloud-wing badge, single blue crystal staff stowed on back) scrambles backward clutching her hat with empty hands in panic. On the right, fierce high-level Orc Warrior ambusher (green plush orc hood with horns and fangs, crimson eyes, spiked red pauldrons) lunges forward grinning wickedly while swinging her battle axe (zero text or letters).

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
어어 보축 어디 있지?!
몰라 내 무적 켜고 튄다!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile high-speed sprinting shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal ground dust puffs and open pure white upper-right space. On the left, wide-eyed panicked Undead Paladin (compact one-handed mace and sturdy gold kite shield stowed on back so empty hands pump wildly) sprints furiously leftward wrapped inside a glowing translucent golden Divine Shield bubble aura. On the lower-right, abandoned Skyborne Mage (single blue crystal staff stowed on back) reaches out in shocked betrayal with trembling hands (zero text or letters).

equip_effects: 12초 동안 모든 공격과 주문에 면역이 됩니다. (본인 전용!)

cuts.visual_prompt: Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Skyborne Mage (sky-blue high side-ponytail, tilted blue wizard hat with smiling cloud-wing badge slightly askew, cloud capelet) freezes completely soul-drained with hollow white blank shock eyes, jaw dropped wide open, and giant cold sweat drops in utter disbelief (zero text, letters, or speech bubbles).

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
나 보축 달라니까 본인 무적?!
파티원 버리고 혼자 튀냐?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Orc Warrior (green plush orc hood in right foreground, battle axe resting casually on shoulder while blinking confusedly into the distance) looking down at defeated Skyborne Mage on the left, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal cobblestone ground touch. On the left, Skyborne Mage (blue wizard hat crooked, single blue crystal staff dropped beside her) lies sprawled face-down pounding the stones with tiny fists and swirling dizzy stars in furious disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
보축이랑 무적이 옆 칸이었어…
적 가면 부활시켜 줄게
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view three-quarter wide comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal cobblestone ground touch. On the lower-left, defeated Skyborne Mage (tilted blue wizard hat crooked, single blue crystal staff lying beside her) stays sprawled face-down motionless under a tiny gloomy sigh cloud. On the right, sheepish Undead Paladin (compact one-handed mace and sturdy gold kite shield stowed on back, faint fading golden bubble sparkles around her) looks back over her shoulder waving an awkward empty hand with guilty golden eyes and cold sweat drops.
